purpose: Expanded full-coverage three-state forecasting research, no trading or financial replay
large_train_scope: Only 1m: the 4000-time cap is not binding on coarser grids. Supplement the original sample, then enforce strict endpoints.
context_240m_rule: Historical return lags max(1, floor(60/h)), floor(1440/h), floor(10080/h); first lag is 4h, not an unavailable 1h return.
sample_policy: Exact fixed-band parent training and test indices; larger_train retains parent indices; all neutral outcomes retained
scaler: Unweighted mean/std refitted on each origin and all included training outcomes; winsor bounds train-only for robust variant
weights: Uniform except recency90: exp2(-(origin-training_time)/(90 days)), applied to all three outcome classes and normalized to mean 1
hierarchy: Two logistic fits: move vs neutral on all outcomes; up vs down on mature move outcomes. P(down)=P(move)*(1-P(up|move)), P(neutral)=1-P(move), P(up)=P(move)*P(up|move). No abstention.
ensemble: Mean of current and at most two previous pinned fixed-band logit_uniform models evaluated on CURRENT causal features. Zero new fits; early origins have 1/2 members.
fallback: Disclosed pooled Laplace train prior if any required class has fewer than 32 rows; no estimator fit
boundary: Strict label endpoints before train/calibration cutoffs, exact fixed-band parent split
class_weight_mode: uniform (recency modifies time weights, not class weights)

bootstrap.simultaneous_family: 336 candidate/asset/horizon tasks x 7 controls x 2 metrics = 4704 comparisons, across all expanded variants/horizons/assets, both seed banks

disclosure: Aug-Sep 2026 and fixed bands already revealed. This is a new registered adaptive research attempt, not a new holdout. Binary MLP65 becomes multiclass MLP83; binary exact-flat selective gate is replaced by band-aware full-coverage hierarchy. No frozen base refits.
